messages:
maya: Quicklunch thought: instead of just a diff view, what if the console can run a sandboxed config-preview that replays a small window of real traffic and shows routing + quota hits?
devin: love that. current previews are static rules-only and miss quota interactions.
luca: +1 but ops cost is my worry. replaying even 1k requests per preview could be expensive. we should cap and sample.
tori: UX idea: two preview modes: 'rules-only' (instant) and 'replay' (delayed, more accurate). show expected error bars.
maya: exact. rules-only for quick checks, replay for final signoff. replay mode requires explicit opt-in and RBAC.
devin: on RBAC: limit to owners + config-approvers role. also add a quota for preview-run minutes per team per day.
luca: implementation: create a PreviewRunner service that runs inside staging cluster, consumes config + optional replay_key, executes deterministic routing/eval and quota-sim on a fixed-time window. returns summary.
tori: how do we get replay data? we can persist short anonymized request windows as replay blobs keyed by tenant+time. teams can choose which blob to use.
maya: replay blobs are good. snippet: store compressed proto {seq_len_hist, token_counts, endpoints}. attach retention 7 days and strict access controls.
devin: parity concern: preview logic must be the same as production runtime. maybe compile rule-evaluator into a shared library used by both router and preview-runner.
luca: agreed. also include a version hash in preview results so console can flag stale preview logic.
tori: on UI: show a small "confidence" meter with four levels: heuristic, rules-only, replay-low-sample, replay-high-sample. show raw breakdown link.
maya: operational alerts: preview_match_rate (how often preview predicted the real router for recent shadow runs), preview_cost_tokens, preview_queue_len. trigger page if match_rate drops <99%.
devin: cache: preview results should be stored and deduped by checksum of (config, replay_blob_id, preview_version). return cached result for identical requests to save cost.
luca: edge cases: TTL cache invalidation when routing rules change in other services. include global config epoch in checksum.
tori: testing: unit tests for shared evaluator, an integration test that replays the blob through prod router in shadow mode and compares, and a nightly sweep to surface any divergences.
maya: rollout: start with internal tenants only and manual signoff; then opt-in for 3 customer teams; finally default enable for all with quota limits.
devin: docs: add "how to create a replay blob" guide and a curl sample.
luca: sample curl: \n```\ncurl -X POST https://staging.router/v1/preview \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PREVIEW' \\n  -d '{"config": {...}, "replay_blob": "tenant-42/2026-03-01-1200"}'\n```
tori: encryption: replay blobs might include request metadata. ensure blobs are redacted and stored encrypted with team KMS keys.
maya: cost model: we bill internal teams zero initially, then consider adding a preview-cost chargeback metric for big customers. keep opt-in until stable.
devin: open question: should preview simulate throttles and backoff? my vote: yes, but annotate as "simulated throttle" and expose assumptions.
luca: action items: maya open design doc + data model; devin implement shared rule-evaluator interface; tori mock UI confidence meter; luca add parity job skeleton.
maya: ack
devin: ack
luca: ack
tori: ack
